pattern.short_summary: The user drives the system by speaking, and the spoken utterance occupies the slot that a typed prompt or a direct-manipulation action would otherwise occupy.
pattern.definition: The user drives the system by speaking, and the spoken utterance occupies the slot that a typed prompt or a direct-manipulation action would otherwise occupy. The system's other controls may still exist, but the contributed interaction is that speech is the channel through which intent enters. Papers in this group either build voice as the sole authoring channel or interrogate what happens when voice is collapsed onto the text pipeline.
pattern.structural_signature: An audio-capture channel is the entry point of the control flow; the utterance is converted to an internal command, instruction sequence, or code, and that conversion product is what the rest of the system consumes. Nothing else in the flow requires the user to touch a pointer or keyboard, and the surface that would normally accept typed or pointed input is either absent or bypassed.

dimension.category_description: How interaction crosses sensory, physical, spatial, embodied, or representational channels.
dimension.classification_boundary: The channel, embodiment, or rendering must be the load-bearing interface mechanism.
